name: Royal Enfield Classic 350 / 500
engine: 346 or 499 cc air-cooled single, fuel injected
intro: Royal Enfield's retro single. Simple and slow-revving. Some 2023 bikes are in a reflector recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2023 Classic 350s are in recall 24V713 (side and rear reflectors).

recalls.what: Side and rear reflectors don't meet the lighting standard.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the side and rear reflectors free.

forums.name: ADVrider
forums.what: Large riding forum with Royal Enfield owner threads.
